name: Girish Kumbhar
headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
summary: I architect, debug and deploy high-performance web and mobile applications, with a focus on the MERN stack, React.js and React Native.
intro: I'm a software engineer with 2 years of experience delivering scalable, user-centric products inside collaborative agile teams. My core stack is the MERN stack, React.js and React Native, backed by Next.js, Django and Supabase.

Right now I'm leading the build of AdhyaGuru, an AI-based EdTech platform. Before that, as a founding engineer at Zenovation Solution, I shipped Vokal India, a verified community app that grew past 3,000 members, and Poster Boy, a billboard booking marketplace.
